scenarios.title: Aura swap exchanges the Aura with an Aura card in hand
decisions: A activates Arcanum Wings' aura swap ability, paying {2}{U} with Island, Island, Island.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and A chooses to exchange.

variants.label: aura_in_hand
variants.expected: Arcanum Wings moves to A's hand. Holy Strength enters attached to Grizzly Bears, which is a 3/4 without flying.

variants.label: no_aura_in_hand
variants.delta: A's hand holds Grizzly Bears instead of Holy Strength.
variants.expected: There is no Aura card to exchange. Arcanum Wings stays on Grizzly Bears (a 2/2 with flying) and A's hand is unchanged.

detector.outcome: An aura swap ability resolves and an Aura card moves from its controller's hand to the battlefield.
detector.near_miss: An aura swap ability resolves with no Aura card moving from the hand to the battlefield.

scenarios.title: The exchange fails if the Aura in hand cannot enchant the permanent
decisions: A activates Arcanum Wings' aura swap ability, paying {2}{U} with Island, Island, Island.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and A chooses to exchange with Wild Growth.

variants.label: cannot_enchant
variants.expected: Wild Growth (enchant land) cannot enchant Grizzly Bears, so the ability has no effect. Arcanum Wings stays on Grizzly Bears and Wild Growth stays in A's hand.

variants.label: can_enchant
variants.delta: A's hand holds Holy Strength (enchant creature) instead of Wild Growth.
variants.expected: The exchange succeeds. Arcanum Wings moves to A's hand and Holy Strength enters attached to Grizzly Bears.

detector.outcome: An aura swap ability resolves with no zone change: one half of the exchange cannot be completed.
detector.near_miss: An aura swap ability resolves and moves a card between zones.

scenarios.title: The exchange fails if the Aura on the battlefield is controlled but not owned

setup.notes: Arcanum Wings is owned by B and controlled by A.

decisions: A activates Arcanum Wings' aura swap ability, paying {2}{U} with Island, Island, Island.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and A chooses to exchange with Holy Strength.

variants.label: not_owner
variants.expected: The exchange cannot be completed, so the ability has no effect. Arcanum Wings stays on Grizzly Bears and Holy Strength stays in A's hand.

variants.label: owner
variants.delta: Arcanum Wings is owned by A as well as controlled by A.
variants.expected: The exchange succeeds. Arcanum Wings moves to A's hand and Holy Strength enters attached to Grizzly Bears.

operation.unclassifiable: not a board edit: ownership of a permanent is a property no operation sets

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs an Aura owned by one player and controlled by the other, for example after a control-changing effect on the Aura.

detector.outcome: An aura swap ability resolves with no zone change: one half of the exchange cannot be completed.
detector.near_miss: An aura swap ability resolves and moves a card between zones.
